required_claude_source.actual_application: strict-N3 Walsh rank2-cross plus diffuse hyperbolic family has rank3 cut singular values 1,1,1, Z=e3=1 and row marginals 2/m or 1/m, giving density <=6sqrt(e)

partner.actual_application: Q_eps=2X1X5+2X2X6+eps(X3^2+X4^2)+2X7X8 gives partner bound <3.488 eps^(-1/3); new hyperbolic receiver gives <=3*2^(2/3) uniformly

new_result.statement: For an exact rank-two original-coordinate bicore with singular product Delta and a source-disjoint exact hyperbolic packet 2bUV+alpha U+beta V with density caps N_U,N_V, the full conditional/unconditional form has density sup <=3*2^(2/3) Delta^(-1/3)(N_U N_V/|b|)^(1/3). With linear-projection caps and Gamma=|b|||u||||v|| this is <=6(Delta Gamma)^(-1/3).
new_result.mechanism: borderline rank2 projected-Plancherel 1/|t| times source-disjoint hyperbolic L2(time), optimized by a low/high frequency split

supporting_sharpening.statement: For independent density caps N_U,N_V, ||p_(UV)||_2 <=2sqrt(2)sqrt(N_U N_V), improving the prior constant 4; this is only a constant sharpening of existing product-L2 work.

next_step: In arbitrary strict N3 low-cross-rank states, force a strong source-disjoint hyperbolic packet, a definite cross-kernel partner packet, an overlapping transverse grouped-Fresnel packet, or another paid volume/ridge/hub/grouped-square/exact-null/physical-pair exit before paying a tiny determinant.
